name: Counterfactual Firewall Policy Synthesis
capability_claim: Faithful executable modeling and exact optimization of compositional access-policy constraints.
solver_access: Only solver_bundle/ is solver-visible; it contains the complete rules and public instance data.
task: Choose a minimum-cost permission-revocation set that keeps all services operational and blocks all attacks.
answer_format: A comma-separated, lexicographically increasing permission tuple without spaces, or NONE.
objectives_in_order: lexicographically smallest increasing tuple of permission names
novelty_claim: CFPS uses a compact policy DSL whose asymmetric service and attack semantics create coupled safety and interdiction constraints; it scores the exact canonical optimum rather than explanation quality or generic code output.
external_solvability: All permission costs and all recipe/channel structures are in the solver packet. A qualified solver can evaluate every one of the finite 2^18 revocation sets (or encode the same Boolean optimization in SAT/ILP), so the optimum and tie-break are identifiable without private information.
